note: The IEOM's observatory of bank charges in the French Pacific (prices at 1 April 2026), French Polynesia's table: the yearly price, in CFP francs, of each bank's international deferred-debit card, whose month's spending the bank takes from the account at once, so nothing is carried on it. The banks' revolving credit isn't in the table and isn't kept. On 2026-10-30 the range was widened from the banks' own price lists. Banque de Tahiti's tariffs for private customers (1 January 2026): the Visa Classic deferred-debit card at 5,446 CFP francs a year (the same figure the IEOM gives), the Visa Premier at 22,328 and the Visa Infinite at 55,843; a card payment or withdrawal outside the European Union costs 2.80%, at most 842 francs a payment (the ceiling not modelled). Banque Socredo's general tariff conditions (from 1 May 2026): the Visa Classic deferred-debit card at 5,373 francs a year (as the IEOM gives) and the Visa Premier at 21,700; a card payment outside the euro zone costs 2.50%. Each is a deferred-debit card, so nothing is carried; immediate-debit versions (debit cards), the Socredo and Tiare private cards (systematic-authorisation debit cards), discounts for a second card and packages aren't written, nor the American Express, Centurion and Air Tahiti Nui cards Socredo prices as 'nous consulter'. Banque de Polynésie's site didn't answer (no connection), so only the IEOM's figure is written for it.
